styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm tropical-stage oral-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of apricot-peach gradient backdrop #F9E0C6 to #EFB488, fresh mint green #BFE8D2 and #7FD6A6, cream card #FFF8EF, deep charcoal text #3B3B3B and one champagne-gold accent #D8B36C; bright soft warm studio lighting with front-top key and soft contact shadows; heavy modern sans-serif headlines with a short mint brush underline; thin-line mint icons inside flat white circular chips; product presented upright on a round mint podium or flanking rounded info cards at a stable slight 3/4 scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no second accent color.

provenance.notes: 从 7 屏爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离店铺会员二维码徽标、原文案与全部原始数值（防水等级、续航、震动频率、电池、刷丝品牌等一律交由 {callout_n} 文案槽在生成时填写）。源图混排了冲牙器话术（水箱/喷嘴/水压），已按牙刷主体归一为通用清洁模式描述；刷头微距用通用刷毛描述，不复刻任何真人或齿面。产品以 {product} 占位，可复用于任意细锥颈环三挡电动牙刷。
